Admin.title: Admin
Admin.intro: Run Shelf’s jobs now, on the server, instead of waiting for the night’s run. A long job carries on by itself, a few minutes at a time, until it’s done.

locked.label: Password
locked.failed: The server didn’t answer. Try again.

Admin.off: The admin page is off on this server: it has no ADMIN_PASSWORD.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.failed: It didn’t start: the server didn’t answer.

steam-pages-new.name: Steam pages of new games
steam-pages-new.what: Reads the store page of each game on Steam that was never read: its cover, art, screenshots and description.

steam-pages.name: Every Steam page
steam-pages.what: Reads every game’s store page on Steam again: covers, art, screenshots and descriptions that changed there, and what Shelf reads now that it didn’t before.

steam-reviews.name: Steam scores
steam-reviews.what: Reads what Steam’s players say of every game sold there.

igdb.name: IGDB records
igdb.what: Asks IGDB about every game again, and keeps what changed.

sync.name: Daily sync
sync.what: Syncs every Steam and Nintendo account that syncs each day, as the night’s run does.

everything.name: Everything
everything.what: IGDB records, then Steam scores, then every Steam page.
